title: Cosmic Reflection
definition: A digital universe designed to mirror the human mind, bridging disparate disciplines and revealing the interconnected nature of existence.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A digital library that helps us understand the world by connecting different ideas and showing their interconnectedness.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A digital mirror of the human mind that aims to unite various fields to provide a comprehensive understanding of existence.
difficulty_levels.expert: A digital universe that reflects the structure of the human mind, aiming to reveal the interconnected nature of existence and solve global problems.

extra_fields.insight: The concept of a digital universe designed to help humanity understand existence better.
